email.subject: MV FERN ESTUARY - Red Sea passage declined (war risks)
email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV FERN ESTUARY, Fujairah to Antwerp

Owners decline to transit Bab el-Mandeb on this voyage under the war risks clause, given the latest security warning. Please give other orders: we suggest the Cape of Good Hope.

Best regards,
Marine department
Owner's vessel technical management (Fern Estuary Shipping, fictional)

output.off_hire_clause: Off hire (fictional, modelled on NYPE 1993 clause 17): in the event of loss of time from breakdown of, or damage to, hull, machinery or equipment, or any other similar cause preventing the full working of the vessel, the payment of hire shall cease for the time thereby lost. Rider (fictional): in the event of a breakdown of the vessel's cargo cranes, hire shall be reduced pro rata for the time lost, in the proportion that the number of cranes out of use bears to the total number of cranes.
output.war_risks_clause: War risks (fictional, modelled on BIMCO CONWARTIME 2013): the vessel shall not be obliged to proceed through any area where, in the reasonable judgement of the Master and/or the owners, she may be exposed to war risks. If the owners so decide, the charterers shall give other orders, and the vessel shall proceed by an alternative route. Extra time and bunkers on that route are for the charterers' account.
